tasks.label: fuzz-log
args: $j=((gh run view 34189460354 --json jobs | ConvertFrom-Json).jobs | Where-Object name -eq 'fuzz').databaseId; gh run view 34189460354 --log-failed --job=$j 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern 'panicked|##\[error\]|Running:|crash-|timeout|SUMMARY|attempt to|Base64|MS: ' | Select-Object -First 25 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line } | Set-Content .copilot-tmp/fuzz-fail.txt; Get-Content .copilot-tmp/fuzz-fail.txt

tasks.label: fuzz-log
args: Set-Location 'e:\gh\HIDE'; New-Item -ItemType Directory .copilot-tmp -Force | Out-Null; $j=((gh run view 34189460354 --json jobs | ConvertFrom-Json).jobs | Where-Object name -eq 'fuzz').databaseId; gh run view 34189460354 --log-failed --job=$j 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 .copilot-tmp/fuzz-log.txt; 'written'
